business_problem: Availity needed faster access to scattered enterprise knowledge, source-code context, and large analytics datasets because employees were spending too much time retrieving information for data analysis, software development, and release management.
solution_summary: Availity deployed multiple Amazon Q services to make enterprise knowledge, code, and analytics easier to use across its healthcare network operations. Amazon Q Business provides conversational assistants that retrieve information from scattered documentation and participate in release-management workflows, including automatically analyzing committed changes from source control. Amazon Q Developer accelerates software-development tasks such as code generation, formatting, issue analysis, and migration troubleshooting, while Amazon Q in QuickSight lets users query Availity’s large enterprise datasets in natural language and generate business explanations and visuals for the company’s digital newspaper report. Together, these components connect internal knowledge bases, source-code repositories, and analytics data into a unified AI-assisted workflow that reduces search effort, shortens review cycles, and helps teams make decisions faster.
